a:s.a:s: /* * Library: IMMZ.IND.37 Logic * Drop-out rate from the 1st dose of measles and rubella-containing vaccine to the 2nd dose * The percentage in the target population who received a 1st dose of measles and rubella-containing vaccine in the primary series but have not received the 2nd dose of measles and rubella-containing vaccine in the primary series (i.e. are past due for measles and rubella-containing vaccine 2nd dose) during the reporting period * * Numerator: Number of clients who received a 1st dose of measles and rubella-containing vaccine during the reporting period who should have received the 2nd dose of measles and rubella-containing vaccine during the reporting period but did not receive it * Numerator Computation: (COUNT of clients with an immunization event WHERE "Vaccine type"" = "Measles and rubella-containing vaccines" for the 1st dose in the primary series AND "Date and time of vaccination" is during the reporting period) - (COUNT of clients with an immunization event WHERE "Vaccine type"" = "Measles and rubella-containing vaccines" for the 2nd dose in the primary series AND "Date and time of vaccination" is during the reporting period) * Denominator: Number of clients in the target population who received dose 1 of measles and rubella-containing vaccine during the reporting period * Denominator Computation: COUNT clients with an immunization event WHERE "Vaccine type" = "Measles and rubella-containing vaccines" for a 1st dose in the primary series AND "Date and time of vaccination" is during the reporting period * * Disaggregation * - Administrative area * - Sex * - Age in years * - Age group (depending on schedule) * * References: WHO Immunization facility analysis guide (5) * * Annotations: – */ library IMMZIND37Logic
/* * As defined by Member State */ define "Initial Population": true

a:t.name: denominator
a:t.value: Number of clients in the target population who received dose 1 of measles and rubella-containing vaccine during the reporting period

a:t.name: pseudocode
a:t.value: "Vaccine type" = "Measles and rubella-containing vaccines" for a 1st dose in the primary series AND "Date and time of vaccination" is during the reporting period

a:t.name: note
a:t.value: Updated to include those who have received the first dose and are due for the second during the measurement period

a:s.a:s: "Measles and Rubella Doses Administered to Patient"

operand.name: Measles and Rubella Doses Administered to Patient

a:t.name: numerator
a:t.value: Number of clients who received a 1st dose of measles and rubella-containing vaccine during the reporting period who should have received the 2nd dose of measles and rubella-containing vaccine during the reporting period but did not receive it

a:t.name: pseudocode
a:t.value: "Vaccine type"" = "Measles and rubella-containing vaccines" for the 1st dose in the primary series AND "Date and time of vaccination" is during the reporting period) - (COUNT of clients with an immunization event WHERE "Vaccine type"" = "Measles and rubella-containing vaccines" for the 2nd dose in the primary series AND "Date and time of vaccination" is during the reporting period)

a:t.name: note
a:t.value: Only include those from the denominator that did not receive a measles/rubella 2nd dose during the measurement period. Those where the 2nd dose due date is during the period but have not received the 2nd dose.

a:s.a:s: "Measles and Rubella Doses Administered to Patient During Measurement Period"

operand.name: Measles and Rubella Doses Administered to Patient During Measurement Period

a:t.name: disaggregation
a:t.value: Administrative area Sex Age in years Age group (depending on schedule)
